stationary: reference actor tangent, no target-time advance
moving: nearest projection onto given actor reference polyline then forward arc lookahead
endpoint: tangent virtual direction only, not added to planned trajectory
evaluation: unchanged absolute time; full failures retained
continue_to_L2: only if S2 completes with no abort/collision/delivery error and original lateral/yaw/geometry bounds pass; longitudinal-only quality failure does not prevent this independent lateral diagnostic
